farmersdelight.advancement.root.desc: Welcome to Huidu's Farmer's Delight CE addon! A world of flavor awaits you!
farmersdelight.advancement.craft_knife.d: Craft a Knife to scavenge extra goods from plants and animals
farmersdelight.advancement.harvest_straw: Harvest grass, wheat or rice with a Knife to collect Straw
farmersdelight.advancement.place_organic: Place down some Organic Compost. It composts better with sun, water and mushrooms!
farmersdelight.advancement.get_rich_soil: Let an Organic Compost finish maturing into Rich Soil
farmersdelight.advancement.get_ham.desc: Use a Knife to extract Ham from Pigs or Hoglins
farmersdelight.advancement.use_cutting_b: With a tool in hand, use a Cutting Board to break down an item
farmersdelight.advancement.obtain_nether: If You Can't Take the Heat...
Spend a whole Netherite Ingot to upgrade your knife! Or get out of the kitchen.
farmersdelight.advancement.get_fd_seed.d: Four new crops may be found in the wild, across many climates...
farmersdelight.advancement.plant_rice.de: Plant grains of Rice in a shallow water puddle
farmersdelight.advancement.harvest_ropel: Hang some rope above a tomato crop to make it grow taller
farmersdelight.advancement.hit_raider_wi: Throw a Rotten Tomato at one of these pesky raiders!
farmersdelight.advancement.get_organic_c: Craft your first Organic Compost and start enriching the earth
farmersdelight.advancement.hoe_rich_soil: Till Rich Soil with a hoe to make Rich Soil Farmland
farmersdelight.advancement.get_mushroom_: Shear a fully mature Mushroom Colony. To grow them like this, you'll need a very rich soil...
farmersdelight.advancement.plant_all_cro: Cultivate every food-related plant you can find, such as vegetables, fruits, fungi or roots!
farmersdelight.advancement.place_campfir: Place down a Campfire to cook some food
farmersdelight.advancement.use_skillet.d: Skillets let you cook on the go. (Holding cooking not yet implemented)
farmersdelight.advancement.place_skillet: Sneak to place your Skillet down as a block
farmersdelight.advancement.place_cooking: Put down a Cooking Pot and start preparing meals!
farmersdelight.advancement.eat_nourishin: Plated meals will prevent you from getting exhausted or hungry for a while!
farmersdelight.advancement.place_feast.d: Some meals are big enough to be placed down and shared with friends!
farmersdelight.advancement.master_chef.d: Eat a course of every meal available!
